description: Get the official annual average CPI of one category (the BLS M13 rows, published NSA only). Headline "all-items" covers every year since 1913 — with limit=150 the complete series fits in one call. Ideal for long-run inflation comparisons and "how much has $X in year Y grown" questions.

category.description: CPI category. "all-items" is headline inflation; "core" excludes food and energy.

end.description: Inclusive end year (YYYY). Pass meta.next_end here to get the next page.

limit.description: Max points per page (1-150, default 50; 150 = the whole headline series).

name: get_us_inflation_annual
title: US inflation annual averages
